head: codex/4644-v0917-docs-alignment
title: [v0.91.7][WP-17] #4644 Align documentation and adoption truth
body:
Closes #4644

Aligns the repository review entry points, every tracked README, all v0.91.7 milestone and feature documentation, six Cargo manifests, and the accepted/deferred ADR indexes with current evidence. Retains an executable WP-17 audit packet covering 208 README files, 822 local links, 1,328 v0.91.7 files, structured-artifact exceptions, ADR integrity, and locked Cargo metadata.

Validation: the issue-owned documentation validator passed; typed csdlc-validate and csdlc-doctor passed; git diff hygiene passed. Review: bounded exact-revision subagent review found no actionable findings after repairs, and the metadata-only follow-up review confirmed coherent lifecycle truth.

Non-claims: this documentation issue does not claim broad runtime, provider, security, observability, cloud, Unity, GPU, adaptive-learning, or v0.92 activation readiness. #5408 and downstream closeout WPs remain independent gates. No AWS command or service was used.
